title: UVM TC Subskill Input 3.0.0
description: Agent input contract 3.0.0. Explicit source/profile/plan and UVM identities required. Prepared sources are normalized by the parent, not converted by this subskill. No platform or sheet default.

source_mode.description: Explicit selection; prepared is the recommended parent workflow, not an implicit default.

sheet_name.description: Required for excel: explicit existing sheet; no first-sheet fallback.

prepared_testpoints.description: Parent-normalized points/cases with stable IDs and original source references. Parent checks ID uniqueness and full input accounting.

prepared_input_ref.description: Reference to parent-normalized MD/JSON/CSV input retaining stable point IDs/source_ref; parent checks existence, content and source hashes. No converter is implemented here.

platform_dir.description: Existing integrated platform; parent verifies allowed write scope.

platform_type.description: Required: 1=Superbench, 2=Gaea; no default. Mapping is defined in manifest.yaml.

approved_plan_ref.description: Reference to approved plan/version; parent verifies approval and all input dispositions.

user_prompt.description: Supplemental request; cannot override approved plan or read-only boundaries.
